description: This file contains a set of unit tests for Orleans streaming system routing, specifically testing persistent streaming over a single gateway configuration. It includes test fixture setup, configuration, and an actual test method that verifies stream production and consumption behavior.

classes.name: SystemTargetRouteTests
classes.description: A test class for checking the routing behavior of persistent streaming over a single gateway in Orleans. It sets up a test cluster fixture, initializes test parameters, and runs the streaming test.

classes.name: SystemTargetRouteTests.Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class for setting up Orleans test cluster with specific configurations for streaming and storage.

methods.name: PersistentStreamingOverSingleGatewayTest
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that creates multiple streams, subscribes to them, produces events, and verifies the correct consumption of all events.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a stream item, increments the counter of consumed events.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Checks if the number of consumed events matches the number produced, asserting equality.
